caption:
I should go. Still here

I should go. Still here.

After a conversation, people tend to underestimate how much the other person enjoyed it, so staying a little longer is rarely the imposition it feels like.

For whoever stays for one more story.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one on the right. The black one says I should go, the blue one says stay!, the black one says one more story, then I really should go, and the blue one says one more! Both end with happy eyes. In the last seconds the text changes from: me saying I should go, to: 11:40. still here.
